question: Schedule VII of the Constitution contains _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three legislative lists**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Schedule VII** of the **Constitution of India** deals with the division of powers between the **Union** and **State governments**. It contains **three legislative lists**: Union List, State List, and Concurrent List.
 
• The **Union List** includes subjects of national importance, such as **defense, foreign affairs, atomic energy, and banking**. The Parliament of India has exclusive power to legislate on these matters.
